offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；每次搜索消耗固定数量的 token，starting from 10000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Free. Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和网页内容，转换为干净、适合 LLM 的文本；JSON 模式返回五项列表
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；免费密钥100 RPM，付费100 RPM，高级密钥1000 RPM。
